title: Payslip delivery: an email fallback that never runs
name: Payslip delivery

questions.prompt: After November payroll, HR's follow-up list had 41 employees marked "undelivered" with errors like "550 mailbox unavailable". These are people whose work email bounced, mostly leavers and people who moved to the new domain. They should have received a printed payslip, but the print vendor got no letters for any of them and the fallback log line never appears. Fix payroll/delivery.ts so the tests pass.
